# Enter the tavern. Start a fight

**Physics-based VR brawler**   

 Grab a stool, throw a mug, use anything you can reach. In TaVRn's Takedown, you physically punch, block, and brawl your way through chaotic fantasy taverns. Fists first. Strategy optional.

[media]

**Real physics. Real impact.**

Room-scale VR combat that puts you inside the brawl. Duck, wind up, swing. You feel every hit, because you're actually throwing it.

[media]

**Unlock wild powers every run**

Drink magical brews after each run to unleash absurd abilities. 

[media]

**Voiced by the cast of Baldur's Gate 3**

Tim Downie, Andrew Wincott, Tracy Wiles, plus Luke Dale (Kingdome Come: Deliverance), Corin Nemec (Stargate SG-1) and Terrence Stone (Hearthstone). Yes, really.

**Set in the Naheulbeuk universe**

A cult French fantasy franchise, absurd humor, memorable characters, hidden references everywhere. No lore required to enjoy the chaos.


**Step in. Swing first. Think never.**
